hypotheses.T0_tangent_predicts_finite_product_direc: Median tangent-versus-finite product cosine is at least 0.50 at Layer 0 and 0.30 at Layer 1 on both corpora.
hypotheses.T1_tangent_router_is_causally_useful: Rank-256 tangent-local selection reaches at least 0.40 downstream fidelity at Layer 0 and 0.25 at Layer 1 on both corpora.
hypotheses.T2_tangent_beats_state_free_weights: Tangent-local exceeds static-decoder fidelity by at least 0.20 in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.T3_tangent_closes_most_of_oracle_gap: Tangent-local retains at least 60% of realized-local fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.T4_tangent_router_transfers_ood: TinyStories tangent-local fidelity is at least 75% of FineWeb fidelity at each layer.
hypotheses.T5_tangent_support_is_predictive: Median tangent-local versus realized-local top-256 Jaccard is at least 0.08 in every cell.
hypotheses.T6_mechanistic_router_beats_frozen_ident: Tangent-local exceeds the better frozen global/family bank by at least 0.15 in every cell.
hypotheses.T7_base_activity_is_not_enough: Tangent-local exceeds base-active fidelity by at least 0.10 in every cell.
hypotheses.T8_layer0_is_more_locally_linear: Product-direction cosine at Layer 0 exceeds Layer 1 by at least 0.10 on both corpora.
